testo: ■ As you put this creature into the battle zone, you may put this creature on top of your head and say, "shichifukujin is coming!" If you do, let it fall from your head into the battle zone, and when it lands, put all your opponent's cards in the battle zone that this creature is touching into his graveyard.
testo_jp: （このクリーチャーがバトルゾーンに出る時、それを頭の上に乗せて「七福神のお出ましだ!」と言ってもよい。そうしたら、頭の上のこのクリーチャーをバトルゾーンに振り落とし、それに触れている相手のクリーチャーをすべて持ち主の墓地に置く。）
